name: Direct TCP over QUIC
how: Each player's app punches a UDP path to the host's app, then carries the game's TCP connection inside QUIC.
needs: Routers that keep one outside port per socket (endpoint-independent NAT). Most home routers do.
latency: Direct path between the two PCs

name: Direct UDP over QUIC datagrams
how: The same punched path, carrying a game's UDP packets as QUIC datagrams.
needs: Same router behaviour as Direct TCP.
latency: Direct path between the two PCs

name: Relayed fallback
how: When punching fails (strict NAT, carrier-grade NAT), traffic goes through a relay such as Cloudflare's TURN service.
latency: Adds the trip to the relay; relay traffic may cost money

name: Presence only
how: No connection between players: account, status, friends and In game only. The game uses its own servers.
needs: Nothing beyond the app being online.
